title: Austin Paves Streets, Adjusts Taxes, Settles Suit
summary:
Here's a summary of the Austin City Council agenda:

*   **Major Street Upgrades & Paving:** The Council approved significant infrastructure projects, including improvements for West 6th, East 5th, and San Jacinto streets, finalizing the paving of 19th Street, and funding the paving of Lavaca Street, notably a section near the Governor's Mansion.
*   **New Tax Assessment Policy:** A city-wide policy was adopted to standardize the valuation of corporate securities, notes, and banking capital at 80% of their face value for tax purposes, aiming for fair and equal taxation.
*   **Preparing for City Growth & Public Order:** A "Cemetery Purchase Fund" was established with over $6,800 specifically for acquiring additional land, indicating plans for future city expansion. An ordinance to prohibit "fowls" (like chickens) from running at large in a designated district was also introduced.
*   **Resolving a Property Lawsuit:** To settle a lawsuit with Mrs. Erin Rutherford, the city agreed to extensive property improvements including building a retaining wall, curbing, steps, and sidewalks around her property, in addition to covering court costs and a small cash payment.

. Councilman Hart offered the following resolution : It appearing to the City Council that
the LAST NOTEexecuted for the construction of the tenth Ward Fire Hall ,endorsed by
numerous citizens and assumed by the City in the sum of twenty five hundred ($ 2,500.)
dollars and the further sum of $ 419.89 being two years and six days interest, and now
held and owned by the Austin National Bank is now due and unpaid.
That an appropriation of twenty five hundred ($ 2,500.) dollars was made in the present
budget in the Fire Dept for the payment of same,but not including amount due for interest
; Therefore, Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : That a warrent be
drawn in favor of the Austin National Bank,the present holders and owners of said note,
for said sum of $ 2,500.,as appropriated, and the further sum of $ 419.89,the interest due
thereon, ; upon the presentation of said note properly cancelled,the payment of these
amounts being in full satisfaction of all indebtedness due upon said Fire Hall.The
interest to be charged to the appropriation made in said budget for repairs to Fire Halls.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Bartholomew, Hart,Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

Councilman Powell offered the following resolution : Be is r solved by the City Council of
the City of Austin : That the suit of Mrs Erin Rutherford Vs The City of Austin ,No 25852,
in the District Court of Travis County ,53rd Judicial District of the State of Texas, be
compromised, adjusted and settled upon the following terms: The City agrees to build a
proper retaining wall of suitable height and proper finish entirely around said premises
from the West end of Lot 7, Block 96, City of Austin,Texas, on 9th street to San Jacint to
street a distance of about 128 feet and to a servant's house on the property line of said
property on San Jacinto street'.
The City of Austin also agrees to build a curbing entirely ar round said premises both on
9th street and on San Jacinto street .
It likewise agrees to provide suitable concrete steps from the sidewalk to the level of
the groundon the North side of said premises at such location as may be designated by Mrs
Erin Rutherford.
It likewise agrees to build a concrete sidewalk of proper width, thickness and finish in
front ofr said premises on 9th street and to the curb line of the street on San Jacinto
street .
It likewise agrees to take down and restore the plank fence on the East side of said
premises for a distance of about 30 feet at the place to be designated by said Mrs Erin
Rutherford ; and in addition thereto it agrees to pay the cost accrued in this suit ,
which to date amounts to $ 18.25, and, finally ,it agrees to pay in cash to Mrs Erin
Rutherford the sum of $ 50.00, All of the above work to be done in accordance with a p
plat prepared by the City Engineer .
The cos ts of this suit and $ 50.00 in money are to be paid out of the cost and damage
fund of the Street Dept.
